item.title: Hammerspoon 2 1.0.0 Beta 4
item.description:
Added

  • hs.windowfilter, a replacement for v1's hs.window.filter: rule-based window filters with events for windows being created, focused, moved, minimized, and joining or leaving the filter (#470)
  • hs.distributednotifications, for listening to and posting macOS distributed notifications (e.g. Music's com.apple.Music.playerInfo) (#479)
  • hs.canvas.animate(), which animates changes to canvas elements and windows with linear, ease-in, ease-out, ease-in-out or custom bezier curves (#477)
  • HSChooser.windowID, the window ID of a shown chooser, for use with hs.window (#459)
  • HSChooser.frame, to read where a chooser is (or will be) on screen, and to move or resize it (#459)
  • hs.task.runAsync() and hs.task.shell() take an input option, a string written to the command's standard input, and TaskBuilder has withInput() (#461)
  • hs.checkForUpdates(), which checks for a new version of Hammerspoon 2 even when it's hidden from both the Dock and the menu bar (#466)
  • hs.spoons.updateAll(), which updates every installed Spoon, logging its progress to the Console and resolving with each Spoon's status (#467)
  • hs.spoons.isUpdating, which is true while hs.spoons.update() or hs.spoons.updateAll() is running (#467)
  • hs.window.frontmostWindow(), which returns the focused window, or the first ordered window if nothing has focus (#469)
  • HSWindow.role and HSWindow.subrole (#470)
  • HSWindow.windowsToEast()/West/North/South() and focusWindowEast()/West/North/South(), to find and focus the nearest window in a direction (#470)
  • Edit > Find… (⌘F) focuses the Console's search field (#473)
  • HSImage.toDataURL() and HSImage.toUint8Array(), which return an image's encoded bytes as a base64 data: URL or a Uint8Array without writing to disk (#478)
  • hs.windowfilter.inaccessibleApplications() and the inaccessibleApplication event, for applications that have turned the Accessibility API off (e.g. some kiosk setups), whose windows no filter can see (#480)

Changed

  • The API docs and TypeScript definitions now document each field of options objects and returned objects, such as hs.mqtt.create()'s options and hs.consoleHistory()'s messages (#460)
  • hs.spoons.updateAll() downloads each source once, however many Spoons were installed from it (#468)
  • hs.osascript scripts that try to show UI (e.g. display dialog) now fail straight away with "No user interaction allowed." instead of hanging forever (#482)

Fixed

  • Setting HSChooser.width after a chooser has been shown now resizes it (#459)
  • The API docs for hs.spoons.use() no longer render as a broken page (#460)
  • Parameter and return value descriptions in the API docs and TypeScript definitions are no longer cut off after their first line (#460)
  • hs.task.runAsync() and hs.task.shell() no longer hang forever when the command reads standard input; standard input is closed once any input has been written (#461)
  • Writing to a task's standard input after it has exited no longer crashes Hammerspoon, and sendInput() no longer blocks Hammerspoon while a large input is being read (#461)
  • Passing null for an optional callback (e.g. hs.task.create()'s onOutput) no longer logs "Unable to create JSCallback" (#465)
  • hs.window.focusedWindow() and isFocused now detect windows that take focus without activating their app, such as Spotlight (#469)
  • Installing several Spoons from the same repository at once (e.g. several hs.spoons.use() calls on first run) now downloads the repository once, not once per Spoon (#468)
  • The Console now always comes to the front when opened from the menu bar or hs.openConsole(), instead of sometimes appearing behind other apps (#473)
  • HSImage.saveToFile() now writes atomically, so other processes never read a partially written image (#476)
  • hs.ipc.start() no longer fails silently when macOS can't start the IPC broker; it re-registers the broker, and logs an error if that doesn't help (#475)
  • Hotkeys, hs.keycodes.map and hs.keycodes.on('change') follow a keyboard layout change right away, even while Hammerspoon 2 is in the background (#474)
  • hs.windowfilter no longer asks an application that has turned the Accessibility API off again every time it's activated (#480)
  • HammerspoonOSAScriptHelper no longer shows as "Not Responding" in Activity Monitor (#482)

Full Changelog: 1.0.0-beta.3...1.0.0-beta.4

item.title: Hammerspoon 2 1.0.0 Beta 3
item.description:
Added

  • Spoons that export bindings get an unbindHotkeys() method, to unbind some or all of the hotkeys bound with bindHotkeys() (#451)
  • hs.canvas.create(), setFrame(), setTopLeft() and hs.ui.window() accept an HSRect/HSPoint, so a window's or screen's frame can be passed directly (#454)
  • hs.window.forID(id), which returns the window with that ID (or null), like v1's hs.window.get() (#457)
  • Menu items in hs.menubar menus and hs.chooser context menus can show a keyboard shortcut with a shortcut field, e.g. shortcut: "⇧⌘N", which chooses the item while the menu is open (it is not a system-wide hotkey; the Dock ignores it in hs.dockicon menus) (#456)

Changed

  • hs.canvas and hs.ui.window() now place windows with y = 0 at the top of the primary screen, matching hs.screen, hs.window and v1. Scripts that converted from bottom-up coordinates need to drop that conversion (#454)
  • The rect passed to hs.ui.window() now covers the whole window, including its title bar, like hs.window's frame (#454)
  • hs.task.runAsync() and hs.task.shell() now reject with an Error (with a useful message) when the command fails, still carrying exitCode, stdout, stderr and reason (#458)

Fixed

  • HSImage.croppedCopy() now measures y from the top of the image, matching screen and window frames, instead of from the bottom (#452)
  • A canvas placed over the menu bar is no longer pushed down below it (#454)
  • A borderless hs.ui.window() placed over the menu bar is no longer pushed down below it (#454)

Full Changelog: 1.0.0-beta.2...1.0.0-beta.3

item.title: Hammerspoon 2 1.0.0 Beta 2
item.description:
Added

  • Homebrew installs: brew install --cask hammerspoon/tap/hammerspoon2, which also puts hs2 on your PATH (#430)
  • Spoons can export bindings, and hs.spoons.load() gives them a ready-made bindHotkeys() for users to bind their own hotkeys to those actions (#441)
  • A path option for hs.spoons.load() and hs.spoons.use(), which loads a Spoon from your own working copy while you develop it, and takes precedence over source (#443)

Changed

  • hs.ax.on() and hs.ax.once() errors now say why a watcher couldn't be started, with the Accessibility error's name in err.code (#438)

Fixed

  • Setting a window's frame (or calling moveAndResize()) to a frame on another screen no longer sometimes leaves it smaller than requested (#429)
  • Hammerspoon 2 no longer crashes when many hs.ui.alerts are on screen while an hs.ui.textPrompt is open (#435)
  • kAXErrorAPIDisabled errors from hs.ax no longer claim Hammerspoon lacks Accessibility permission when only the application has turned the Accessibility API off (#438)
  • After a crash, Hammerspoon 2 no longer waits for you to answer the offer to report it before starting up, and the offer can no longer appear hidden behind other windows (#440)
  • A hs.socket listener on port 0 no longer occasionally makes local clients fail to connect with "Address already in use" (#442)

Full Changelog: 1.0.0-beta.1...1.0.0-beta.2

item.title: Hammerspoon 2 1.0.0 Beta 1
item.description:
Added

  • Spaces support on screens: screen.spaces, screen.currentSpace and screen.addSpace(), plus hs.screen.allSpaces(), focusedSpace(), spaceForID() and spaceForUUID() (#371)
  • HSSpace, for switching to (goto()), removing and inspecting a space and the windows on it (#371)
  • window.spaces and window.moveToSpace(), which moves any app's window to another space without opening Mission Control (#371)
  • hs.screen.on("spaceChange", ...), which reports the screen whose space changed and the spaces it changed from and to (#371)
  • hs.screen.missionControlNames(), openMissionControl(), closeMissionControl(), and toggles for Mission Control, App Exposé, Launchpad and Show Desktop (#371)

Changed

  • The documentation and the update feed have moved to https://www.hammerspoon.org/2/ (#419)
  • Crash reports and the documentation's GitHub links now go to https://github.com/Hammerspoon/Hammerspoon2 (#420)

Full Changelog: 0.0.18...1.0.0-beta.1

item.title: Hammerspoon 2 0.0.18
item.description:
Added

  • hs.screen and hs.window now contain multiple new functions/methods for interacting with macOS Spaces
  • A notification when your config folder or file is missing or can't be read, with a button that opens Settings
  • A notification when your config throws an error while loading, with a button that opens the Console
  • hs.chooser onSelectionChange, called with the row and its choice whenever the selected row changes
  • url property on hs.http responses, giving the final URL after any redirects
  • Documentation guides now have linkable section headings, and the sidebar shows an outline of the guide you're reading
  • A "Finding Spoons" section in the Spoons guide
  • The documentation sidebar is now a collapsible tree of every guide, module and type, so you can jump straight to any section, property or method
  • hs.socket.createUnixDatagram(), for sending and receiving Unix domain datagrams, e.g. from Karabiner-Elements' send_user_command
  • hs.consoleHistory(), which returns the messages in the Hammerspoon Console, optionally filtered by level, text, or only those logged since a previous call

Changed

  • The "hs.canvas" documentation guide is now called "Canvas Tutorial"

Fixed

  • hs.ui.textPrompt() now puts the keyboard focus in its text field when it opens, so you can type straight away
  • Hammerspoon no longer crashes at launch if your config file can't be read
  • Clicking a notification no longer also opens the Console when no Hammerspoon windows are open
  • hs.chooser.refreshChoices() no longer leaves selectedRow pointing past the last row when fewer choices match
  • A crash when destroying an hs.ui window containing a web view from a timer or other callback

Full Changelog: 0.0.17...0.0.18

item.title: Hammerspoon 2 0.0.17
item.description:
Added

  • HSMenuBarItem.titleColor, to colour a menu bar item's title (#354)
  • A color key for hs.menubar and hs.dockicon menu entries, to colour their titles (#354)
  • hs.bluetooth, for listing paired and connected Bluetooth devices, their battery levels, connecting and disconnecting them, scanning for nearby devices, reading and writing Bluetooth LE characteristics, and watching for connections and Bluetooth being turned on or off (#357)
  • hs.permissions.checkBluetooth() and hs.permissions.requestBluetooth() (#357)
  • Hammerspoon 2 can now request access to calendars and reminders, so scripts can read them via EventKit (e.g. JXA in hs.osascript, or tools run with hs.task) (#362)
  • HSUIWindow.behavior() and HSUIWindow.behaviorList(), to make a window appear on every Space or over fullscreen apps (e.g. behaviorList(["canJoinAllSpaces", "fullScreenAuxiliary"])) (#364)
  • hs.chooser now supports Page Up / Page Down (or Fn-↑ / Fn-↓) to move through results a page at a time, and Home / End (or Fn-← / Fn-→) to jump to the first / last result (#369)
  • hs.wifi.configuration() and hs.wifi.cachedScanResults(), which return the configuration and cached scan results that used to be part of hs.wifi.interfaceDetails() (#370)
  • hs.spoons.use(), which installs a Spoon from a GitHub repository or zip URL if it isn't installed, then loads and configures it, like v1's SpoonInstall (#372)
  • hs.spoons.install(), hs.spoons.update(), hs.spoons.uninstall(), hs.spoons.available() and hs.spoons.installed(), for managing Spoons from GitHub repositories or zip URLs (#372)
  • An "Install Spoons when opened" setting in the Advanced settings tab that turns off automatic installation of double-clicked .spoon2 bundles (#373)
  • hs.chooser choices can opt out of the context menu with contextMenu: false
  • hs.socket, for communicating over raw TCP, UDP and Unix domain sockets
  • HSSocket.enableServerTLS() and HSSocket.enableServerTLSFromKeychain(), which make a listening socket use TLS with a certificate from a PKCS#12 file or the keychain
  • HSSocket.listen() and HSUDPSocket.bind() take an optional local IP address, to accept connections or datagrams on just that address
  • HSSocket.state, HSSocket.connectTimeout and HSSocket.readTimeout, and an optional lossy argument to hs.socket.decodeText()
  • hs.mqtt, an MQTT client for publishing and subscribing to brokers
  • Hammerspoon 2 offers to report a crash as a GitHub issue the next time it launches

Changed

  • HSUIWindow.level() and HSUIWindow.windowTitle() now update a window that's already shown (#364)
  • hs.wifi.interfaceDetails() no longer includes configuration or cachedScanResults, because fetching them leaks memory inside macOS. Use hs.wifi.configuration() and hs.wifi.cachedScanResults() instead (#370)
  • hs.loadSpoon() is now hs.spoons.load(), and its errors have a code (#372)
  • Console results are now formatted like console.log() output (e.g. booleans print as true/false, objects as { a: 1 }) (#378)
  • hs.chooser context menus are now set once for the whole chooser with contextMenu, and report the picked entry and row to a single onContextMenuSelect callback, instead of each choice having its own contextMenu with an action per entry

Fixed

  • HSWindow.isFocused now returns true for the focused window (#358)
  • console.log() of Hammerspoon objects (e.g. an HSApplication) printed undefined {} instead of a description of the object (#359)
  • hs.window:focus() now keeps the requested window in front in applications such as Google Chrome that bring their previous window back after activating (#361)
  • HSCanvas.behaviorList() and HSCanvas.behaviorValue() no longer crash Hammerspoon when given mutually exclusive behaviors (e.g. canJoinAllSpaces with moveToActiveSpace) or a negative bitmask; they throw an Error instead (#364)
  • Reloading the configuration no longer leaks the previous JavaScript environment's memory if fetch() was used (#366)
  • Polling hs.wifi.interfaceDetails() no longer makes Hammerspoon's memory use grow steadily (#370)
  • Errors in Promises that nothing handles, such as a Spoon that fails to load in hs.spoons.use(), are now logged to the Console instead of disappearing (#372)
  • Hammerspoon could freeze when updating an hs.chooser's choices while its callbacks were being garbage collected (#376)
  • hs.timer.doAt() now repeats at repeatInterval instead of only firing once

Full Changelog: 0.0.16...0.0.17

item.title: Hammerspoon 2 0.0.16
item.description:
Added

  • hs.dockicon.setMenu(), which adds extra items to the menu of Hammerspoon's Dock icon, from an array of menu items or a function called each time the menu opens (#334)
  • hs2 --version, and hs2 now warns at startup if the running Hammerspoon 2 is a different build (#335)
  • require("node:sqlite"), an implementation of Node's synchronous SQLite API (DatabaseSync/StatementSync) using the SQLite that ships with macOS, replacing v1's hs.sqlite3 (#339)
  • hs.eventtap.keyStroke(mods, key, app) sends a keystroke with modifiers to a specific application, even in the background, without activating it (#350)
  • hs.eventtap.makeKeyEvent() and hs.eventtap.makeKeyEventWithCode() take an optional array of modifier names (#350)

Changed

  • Hammerspoon 2 now requires macOS 27 or later (#330)
  • hs.osascript async scripts now run in parallel, so their promises resolve in completion order; chain them if you need strict ordering (#330)
  • The hs.ipc broker now exits shortly after hs.ipc stops or Hammerspoon 2 quits, instead of lingering for a minute (#335)
  • HSApplication.title has been renamed to HSApplication.name (#341)
  • HSAXElement.setAttributeValue() and performAction() now throw an Error saying why the Accessibility API refused the change (with the AX error name in err.code), instead of returning false (#349)
  • HSEventTapEvent.flags can now be set, e.g. event.flags = ["cmd", "shift"] (#350)

Fixed

  • A slow or stuck hs.osascript script no longer delays every other script until it finishes (#330)
  • HSFont.custom() and HSFont.system(size, weight) are now callable under their documented names (they were customSize() and systemWeight()) (#338)
  • hs.ui.webview's evalJSResult() and hs.fs.setTags(), addTags() and removeTags() now appear in the documentation (#338)
  • After updating Hammerspoon 2, hs.ipc no longer keeps talking to the IPC broker from the previous version (#335)
  • JSON.stringify() of geometry objects (HSPoint, HSSize, HSRect), HSColor, screens, windows, applications, audio devices, Bonjour services, MIDI devices and OCR results now includes their values instead of producing {} (#340)
  • setAttributeValue() on an hs.ax element now throws an error naming the expected type (e.g. HSPoint for AXPosition) instead of silently returning false when given the wrong kind of value (#342)
  • hs2 no longer mixes its greeting and connection notices into stdout when input is piped or redirected, so its output can be used directly in scripts (#343)
  • hs.window.allWindows(), hs.window.windowsForApp() and app.allWindows now include windows in native fullscreen and on other Spaces (see the docs for one limitation) (#351)
  • hs.window.windowsForApp(null) returns an empty array instead of crashing (#351)

Full Changelog: 0.0.15...0.0.16

item.title: Hammerspoon 2 0.0.15
item.description:
Added

  • hs.eventtap now supports system key events (volume, brightness, media, etc)
  • hs.ui.webview pages can now send messages back into your JS config
  • hs.canvas can now fade canvases when showing/hiding/destroying
  • App updating is now implemented
  • HSAudioDevice objects now support isInUse and jackConnected
  • hs.eventtap.isSecureInputEnabled() and secureInputPID()

Changed

  • Functions/Methods that claim to return null now actually return null instead of undefined
  • hs.ax watchers will now be automatically destroyed when the elements they are watching, are destroyed
  • hs.ui's show() now orders a window to the front if it is called on an already open window
  • hs.httpserver request callback now receives query parameters as an argument
  • hs.hashing is now properly documented as hs.hashing rather than hs.hash
  • hs.midi can now open individual ports of a multi-port device
  • HSImage.copyImage() has been renamed to HSImage.duplicate()
  • hs.hotkey modals can now be created without a hotkey
  • hs.canvas minimumTextSize() can not be used without an existing element
  • HSColor objects can now be created with hex strings, colour names and more.
  • hs.canvas roundedRectRadii can now be specified with different X and Y radii

Fixed

  • hs.ui's show() method no longer recreates the window every time it is called
  • hs.canvas' destroy() method now destroys its entire element tree, to avoid slow memory recovery

New Contributors

  • @blagerweij made their first contribution in #285

Full Changelog: 0.0.14...0.0.15
